title: ReDetect: A Hybrid LLM-GNN Framework for High-Precision Reentrancy Vulnerability Detection in Smart Contracts

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.2: "The Large Language Model (LLM) component, utilizing GPT-4 Turbo, serves as the intelligent front-end ... vulnerability pattern extraction and rule generation."

prompt.location: Sec. 3.2.1-3.2.2 (only abstract/mathematical description: LLM-Extract, LLM-Transform functions; no prompt text anywhere)

claim.metric: none tied to GPT-4 Turbo directly
claim.location: Table 1 / Fig. 1 report precision-recall for the full ReDetect pipeline and for a 'GPT-Reentry' ablation baseline described only as "a general-purpose LLM (similar to GPT models)", not confirmed to be GPT-4 Turbo

data.source: Custom 'Ground-truth Dataset' (45 expert-labeled contracts) and 'Generalization Dataset' (15 unseen contracts); no release/availability statement found

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is used once, offline, to extract and formalize vulnerability patterns/rules from documentation (role A, parser); this step has no reported accuracy of its own. The paper's headline precision/recall numbers belong to the full hybrid system or to the ambiguously-attributed 'GPT-Reentry' baseline, not to an isolated, promptable GPT-4 Turbo call.
